mapper.sql: P.GOODS_NO, P.GOODS_CODE, P.GOODS_NAME_KO, P.GOODS_NAME_EN, P.BRAND_NO, B.BRAND_NAME_KO, B.BRAND_NAME_EN, P.CATEGORY_NO, C.CATEGORY_NAME, P.SELLER_NAME, P.MANUFACTURER, P.ORIGIN_COUNTRY, P.COST_PRICE, P.SALE_PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_PRICE, P.STOCK_QUANTITY, P.SAFETY_STOCK_QUANTITY, P.TAX_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_FEE, P.GOODS_STATUS, P.USE_YN, P.DISPLAY_YN, P.DISPLAY_START_DATE, P.DISPLAY_END_DATE, P.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, P.DETAIL_DESCRIPTION, P.SEARCH_KEYWORDS, P.REG_DATE, P.REG_ID, P.UPDT_DATE, P.UPDT_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT , (SELECT PI.IMAGE_URL FROM goods_image PI WHERE PI.GOODS_NO = P.GOODS_NO ORDER BY PI.REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, PI.SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) REPRESENTATIVE_IMAGE_URL FROM goods_info P LEFT JOIN brand_info B ON B.BRAND_NO = P.BRAND_NO INNER JOIN category_info C ON C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO
ORDER BY P.GOODS_NO DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.otherwise: AND (P.GOODS_NAME_KO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.GOODS_NAME_EN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT BRAND_NO, BRAND_NAME_KO, BRAND_NAME_EN, BRAND_COUNTRY, BRAND_LOGO_IMAGE_URL, DISPLAY_YN, USE_YN, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID, REG_DATE, REG_ID FROM brand_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BRAND_NAME_KO

SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_NAME, CATEGORY_DEPTH, PARENT_CATEGORY_NO, USE_YN, DISPLAY_YN, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID, REG_DATE, REG_ID FROM category_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CATEGORY_DEPTH, CATEGORY_NO
SELECT FROM goods_info P LEFT JOIN brand_info B ON B.BRAND_NO = P.BRAND_NO INNER JOIN category_info C ON C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo}
SELECT GOODS_IMAGE_NO, GOODS_NO, IMAGE_URL, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, REPRESENTATIVE_YN, SORT_ORDER, REG_ID FROM goods_image WHERE GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo} ORDER BY REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, SORT_ORDER

SELECT P.GOODS_NO, P.GOODS_NAME_KO, P.GOODS_NAME_EN, P.BRAND_NO, B.BRAND_NAME_KO, B.BRAND_NAME_EN, P.CATEGORY_NO, C.CATEGORY_NAME, P.SALE_PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_PRICE, P.GOODS_STATUS, (SELECT PI.IMAGE_URL FROM goods_image PI WHERE PI.GOODS_NO = P.GOODS_NO ORDER BY PI.REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, PI.SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) REPRESENTATIVE_IMAGE_URL FROM goods_info P LEFT JOIN brand_info B ON B.BRAND_NO = P.BRAND_NO INNER JOIN category_info C ON C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND P.GOODS_STATUS IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND (P.DISPLAY_START_DATE IS NULL OR P.DISPLAY_START_DATE <= NOW()) AND (P.DISPLAY_END_DATE IS NULL OR P.DISPLAY_END_DATE >= NOW()) ORDER BY P.GOODS_NO DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT P.GOODS_NO, P.GOODS_NAME_KO, P.GOODS_NAME_EN, B.BRAND_NAME_KO, B.BRAND_NAME_EN, C.CATEGORY_NAME, P.SELLER_NAME, P.MANUFACTURER, P.ORIGIN_COUNTRY, P.SALE_PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_PRICE, P.TAX_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_TYPE, P.SHIPPING_FEE, P.GOODS_STATUS, P.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, P.DETAIL_DESCRIPTION FROM goods_info P LEFT JOIN brand_info B ON B.BRAND_NO = P.BRAND_NO INNER JOIN category_info C ON C.CATEGORY_NO = P.CATEGORY_NO WHERE P.GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND P.GOODS_STATUS IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND (P.DISPLAY_START_DATE IS NULL OR P.DISPLAY_START_DATE <= NOW()) AND (P.DISPLAY_END_DATE IS NULL OR P.DISPLAY_END_DATE >= NOW())
SELECT GOODS_IMAGE_NO, IMAGE_URL, REPRESENTATIVE_YN, SORT_ORDER FROM goods_image WHERE GOODS_NO = #{goodsNo} ORDER BY REPRESENTATIVE_YN DESC, SORT_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_info (GOODS_CODE, GOODS_NAME_KO, GOODS_NAME_EN, BRAND_NO, CATEGORY_NO, SELLER_NAME, MANUFACTURER, ORIGIN_COUNTRY, COST_PRICE, SALE_PRICE, DISCOUNT_PRICE, STOCK_QUANTITY, SAFETY_STOCK_QUANTITY, TAX_TYPE, SHIPPING_TYPE, SHIPPING_FEE, GOODS_STATUS, USE_YN, DISPLAY_YN, DISPLAY_START_DATE, DISPLAY_END_DATE, SHORT_DESCRIPTION, DETAIL_DESCRIPTION, SEARCH_KEYWORDS, REG_DATE, REG_ID, UPDT_DATE, UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{goodsCode}, #{goodsNameKo}, #{goodsNameEn}, #{brandNo}, #{categoryNo}, #{sellerName}, #{manufacturer}, #{originCountry}, #{costPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{discountPrice}, #{stockQuantity}, #{safetyStockQuantity}, #{taxType}, #{shippingType}, #{shippingFee}, #{goodsStatus}, #{useYn}, #{displayYn}, #{displayStartDate}, #{displayEndDate}, #{shortDescription}, #{detailDescription}, #{searchKeywords}, NOW(), #{regId}, NOW(), #{regId})

INSERT INTO goods_image (GOODS_NO, IMAGE_URL, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, REPRESENTATIVE_YN, SORT_ORDER, REG_DATE, REG_ID) VALUES (#{goodsNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{originalFileName}, #{representativeYn}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), #{regId})
